opens.openerLine: "Hey." Liam settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"Can we talk?" Dwayne sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"Can we talk?" Ernesto sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"Can we talk?" Liam sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the ridge above the creek."
"Now — Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"About what scares you most — What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"Can we talk?" Nobuo sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Benoit sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"This wound — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"Can I tell you something? I'm saving a candy bar for when things get better. I haven't told anyone."
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"This cut — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. ...sorry, I'm spiraling."
"About this wound — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About this wound — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"This cut — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you take a look?"
Benoit: "I've heard good things about Ashford. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
"Please — I can't shake it. I'm feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. I need help. Please."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"I can't reach this properly. Will you help me clean it?"
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
Onni: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I stole from someone who trusted me. I think about it every day."
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
Liam: "Hey. I want to ask it plain: will you be my bonded friend? I'll watch your back if you watch mine."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
You can tell a lot about a group by how they eat. I want us to eat well.
"About that warning — I keep turning it over."
"About that warning — I keep turning it over. Seen worse."
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"Okay, so — something happened this morning."
"Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"The cistern's nearly dry — 8 liters left. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About how this changed you — Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Water's almost gone — 5 liters. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I ran when I should have stayed. I think about it every day."
"I asked Qhapaq about how this changed you — Qhapaq's gone. Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Stay near tonight? Please. I don't want to be alone when the light goes."
"About the help I asked you for — That night has passed. Let’s leave that request behind."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"About this wound — still on my mind. I keep coming back to it."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
"I've decided to treat this as an extended camping trip. A terrible, endless camping trip."
"About what you believe in — Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
"Can I tell you something? At night I count the stars and name them after people."
"What do you miss most? From before."
"About what you miss most — What do you miss most? From before."
"We're down to 0 liters of clean water. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"I asked Yuki about what you miss most — Yuki's gone. What do you miss most? From before."
"I asked Amina about what you miss most — Amina's gone. What do you miss most? From before."
"I asked Yuki about the creek water run — Yuki's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"Can we talk?" Tegan glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?"
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? I can't keep going like this."
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there. Allegedly."
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
Sarah: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Please — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? I can't keep going like this."
"Tell you what — Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"Can I tell you something? At night I talk to someone who isn't there anymore."
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. My cut needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"The food I needed — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
I've talked down three fights this month. It's a skill. A tiring one.
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"Listen. I need you to hear this before you go back out there."
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"About whether you're staying — Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
The sky split and nobody wants to talk about WHY. I do. I need to know.
"Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
"I asked Rowan about what you're good at — Rowan's gone. What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"I asked Rowan about your plan here — Rowan's gone. So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Can I be honest? Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
Evelyn: "I've heard good things about Ashford. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"About that warning — I keep turning it over."
"I asked Rowan about who you left behind — Rowan's gone. Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
"About what you're good at — What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"About who you left behind — Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
"About that warning — I keep turning it over. Anyway, that's me."
"Can I tell you something? I'm keeping a photo of someone I left behind. I haven't told anyone."
Hold it together. That's my whole philosophy. Hold it together.
Ignorance got us here. Knowledge gets us out. Or it doesn't, but I'd rather know.
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"About what day it is — Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
When I'm gone, I want the story to keep my name in it.
Tegan: "I've heard good things about Ashford. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"I'm sorry — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Can you do anything?"
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"Can I trust you? I mean really."
"About whether they can trust you — Can I trust you? I mean really."
"About the kindest thing someone's done for you — What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
I don't need a statue. I need one good story that outlives me.
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy. — or so they tell me."
Damiano: "Hey. I want to ask it plain: will you be my bonded friend? I'll watch your back if you watch mine."
"I asked Rowan about the food I needed — Rowan's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
